manifest=.ai/task/repair-w53-20260929/PACK-MANIFEST.json
pack_root=evidence/quality/repair-window-53-20260929/orchestration
while IFS=$'\t' read -r source relative_destination expected_sha
 do
  destination="$pack_root/$relative_destination"
  if test -e "$destination"
  then
   cmp -s "$source" "$destination" || { echo "PACK CONFLICT: $destination" >&2; exit 1; }
  else
   mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
   cp "$source" "$destination"
  fi
  actual_sha=$(sha256sum "$destination" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  test "$actual_sha" = "$expected_sha" || { echo "PACK SHA FAILURE: $destination" >&2; exit 1; }
 done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256] | @tsv' "$manifest")
